description: Screen a wallet, token or counterparty before sending funds. Combines sanctions screening, a plain-language token rug verdict and portfolio context in one place, so an agent can decide whether to proceed. USE FOR: - Checking an address against sanctions lists before a payment - Getting a plain-language rug/safety verdict on an ERC-20 token - Seeing what a wallet holds before extending trust or credit - Combining several risk signals into one decision TRIGGERS: - "is this wallet safe", "sanctions check", "OFAC screen", "is this token a rug" - "token safety", "wallet risk", "counterparty risk", "check this address" Sold as x402/MPP pay-per-call tools on Base and Solana; agents pay per successful call.
